summary.text: Phillip Bowers is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 3, having assumed office on November 11, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as certified project manager.

paragraphs.text: Bowers earned bachelor's degrees from Limestone College and South Wesleyan University and a graduate degree from Clemson University.
His career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as a certified project manager, and he previously served on the Pickens County school board for District 2.
He succeeded Jerry Carter in the seat and is assigned to the Education and Public Works Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
